notes: OUTSIDE half of the Net Mouth (scrap, 2x2): a welded cargo net stretched on a rusty frame, hazard tape on the posts, a horseshoe magnet wired to the top brace, junk caught in the mesh. pulling: the net billows, caught bits slide to the throat, the magnet throws mint shimmer arcs (glow layer). damaged: net torn open, a post bent, tape peeling; disabled: scorched, dented, net burnt to strands, sparking.
